{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MSTMgL4EVXJc6CiTVjqQgu","type":"tool_result","content":"25\t  latent half-configuration, not a control).\n26\t- `auth.tenant_role_permissions` and `auth.user_role_assignments`\n27\t  (admin-api entities, created in `1800200000000-CreateAdminEntitySurfaceTables.ts`)\n28\t  have **no `tenantId` column at all** — they derive tenancy via FK to\n29\t  `tenant_roles`.\n30\t\n31\tToday's actual control is **application-layer parameter scoping**: token minting\n32\t(`apps/auth-service/.../token.service.ts`) isolates with explicit\n33\t`WHERE … tr.\"tenantId\" = $X` predicates, and the `auth` PG role is the sole\n34\tclient of the `auth` schema (schema-role isolation).\n35\t\n36\t### The architectural blocker\n37\t\n38\tThe `auth` schema is **cross-tenant by design** (CLAUDE.md D14): login must\n39\tresolve a tenant *before* any tenant context exists, so auth runs on ONE\n40\tconnection pool that does **not** set `app.current_tenant` per request. RLS as\n41\tthe *primary* control would therefore require auth to start setting a per-request\n42\ttenant GUC on its pool — non-trivial, because the earliest auth queries (resolve\n43\ttenant by email/slug) are inherently pre-tenant and must NOT be tenant-filtered.\n44\tThis is exactly the kind of decision an ADR exists to settle, rather than have a\n45\tsingle fix pre-decide.\n46\t\n47\t## Decision (to be ratified)\n48\t\n49\tTwo defensible paths; the team must choose one. The recommendation is **Path A**.\n50\t\n51\t### Path A — RLS as defense-in-depth behind the existing param scoping (RECOMMENDED)\n52\t\n53\t1. Add a `tenantId` column to `tenant_role_permissions` and `user_role_assignments`\n54\t   (nullable → backfill from the FK chain → NOT NULL; blue-green-safe per ADR-012).\n55\t2. Apply `applyTenantRlsToSchema(qr, { includeTables: ['tenant_roles',\n56\t   'tenant_role_permissions', 'user_role_assignments'] })` in a new auth migration —\n57\t   this installs the canonical `tenant_isolation_policy`\n58\t   (`\"tenantId\" = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid`\n59\t   OR a documented bypass GUC).\n60\t3. Set `app.current_tenant` on the auth pool connection **only on the\n61\t   already-tenant-resolved paths** (post-login token mint, tenant-role admin),\n62\t   leaving the pre-tenant login-discovery queries on a bypass. The existing\n63\t   `WHERE tenantId = $X` predicates stay — RLS is the second line that catches a\n64\t   future query that forgets the predicate.\n65\t\n66\tRLS becomes belt-and-suspenders, not a replacement for the app-layer control.\n67\t\n68\t### Path B — App-layer scoping is sufficient; lock it with an invariant\n69\t\n70\tAccept that, for the platform-level cross-tenant `auth` schema, schema-role\n71\tisolation + explicit parameter scoping is the control, and **do not** add DB-RLS\n72\t(avoid the per-request-GUC complexity on a pre-tenant pool). Compensate by adding\n73\ta tier-3 invariant that every query touching `tenant_roles` /\n74\t`tenant_role_permissions` / `user_role_assignments` carries a `tenantId`"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3d8c9426-d683-4913-8f42-637024439b0c","uuid":"1fb4d041-698f-4314-9b77-39ba0eb41a1d","timestamp":"2026-09-21T03:13:41.756Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-ba3c6d2927ef/docs/adr/038-auth-role-table-rls.md","content":"  latent half-configuration, not a control).\n- `auth.tenant_role_permissions` and `auth.user_role_assignments`\n  (admin-api entities, created in `1800200000000-CreateAdminEntitySurfaceTables.ts`)\n  have **no `tenantId` column at all** — they derive tenancy via FK to\n  `tenant_roles`.\n\nToday's actual control is **application-layer parameter scoping**: token minting\n(`apps/auth-service/.../token.service.ts`) isolates with explicit\n`WHERE … tr.\"tenantId\" = $X` predicates, and the `auth` PG role is the sole\nclient of the `auth` schema (schema-role isolation).\n\n### The architectural blocker\n\nThe `auth` schema is **cross-tenant by design** (CLAUDE.md D14): login must\nresolve a tenant *before* any tenant context exists, so auth runs on ONE\nconnection pool that does **not** set `app.current_tenant` per request. RLS as\nthe *primary* control would therefore require auth to start setting a per-request\ntenant GUC on its pool — non-trivial, because the earliest auth queries (resolve\ntenant by email/slug) are inherently pre-tenant and must NOT be tenant-filtered.\nThis is exactly the kind of decision an ADR exists to settle, rather than have a\nsingle fix pre-decide.\n\n## Decision (to be ratified)\n\nTwo defensible paths; the team must choose one. The recommendation is **Path A**.\n\n### Path A — RLS as defense-in-depth behind the existing param scoping (RECOMMENDED)\n\n1. Add a `tenantId` column to `tenant_role_permissions` and `user_role_assignments`\n   (nullable → backfill from the FK chain → NOT NULL; blue-green-safe per ADR-012).\n2. Apply `applyTenantRlsToSchema(qr, { includeTables: ['tenant_roles',\n   'tenant_role_permissions', 'user_role_assignments'] })` in a new auth migration —\n   this installs the canonical `tenant_isolation_policy`\n   (`\"tenantId\" = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid`\n   OR a documented bypass GUC).\n3. Set `app.current_tenant` on the auth pool connection **only on the\n   already-tenant-resolved paths** (post-login token mint, tenant-role admin),\n   leaving the pre-tenant login-discovery queries on a bypass. The existing\n   `WHERE tenantId = $X` predicates stay — RLS is the second line that catches a\n   future query that forgets the predicate.\n\nRLS becomes belt-and-suspenders, not a replacement for the app-layer control.\n\n### Path B — App-layer scoping is sufficient; lock it with an invariant\n\nAccept that, for the platform-level cross-tenant `auth` schema, schema-role\nisolation + explicit parameter scoping is the control, and **do not** add DB-RLS\n(avoid the per-request-GUC complexity on a pre-tenant pool). Compensate by adding\na tier-3 invariant that every query touching `tenant_roles` /\n`tenant_role_permissions` / `user_role_assignments` carries a `tenantId`","numLines":50,"startLine":25,"totalLines":112}}}
